Native assertions now select visible controls among mounted document panels, await the real BUSY interval before checking REVIEW_REQUIRED, and use the restored process token. These preliminary failed runs are not passing evidence.

limits: Functional ASCII/symbol repertoire and representative layouts only; no universal Unicode or every-screen guarantee. Default missing checkmark/sprint pips/decorative storm symbols remain warnings.
Unknown-language generated glyphs, bitmap ASCII sheet, zoom, font sizes, imports and live font replacement are outside scope.
Screens apply saved profiles at next initialization; ordinary text previews use saved dependencies, not another draft.
